review: 706.3c-1: the roll-again choice was fixed only after the first roll, leaving the 16, 16, 3 variant's second choice open; the decision now fixes rolling again after every 15-20 result.
706.3a-1: the roll 1 variant's delta also named 'A does not search', a consequence rather than a second fact; removed it.

706.6-1: with Berserker's Frenzy the lower roll is always the ignored one, so the 'kept roll too low' variant flipped Steel Squirrel's 5-or-higher condition rather than 706.6, and no single-fact change could stop the ignoring; rebuilt it around Wyll, Blade of Frontiers (its presence toggles the ignore) with Complaints Clerk's roll-a-1 trigger as observer, so ignoring the 1 is what suppresses the token.

scenarios.title: The final die result is the natural result plus modifiers, and the range containing it picks the effect

setup.notes: The natural d20 result is fixed by the scenario, not random.

decisions: A casts Song of Inspiration targeting Grizzly Bears in A's graveyard, tapping five Forests.
Both players pass; Song of Inspiration resolves.
A rolls a d20; the natural result is 12.

variants.label: total 14
variants.expected: Final result is 12 + 2 (Grizzly Bears' mana value) = 14, in the 1-14 range. Grizzly Bears moves to A's hand. A gains no life (20). Song of Inspiration moves to A's graveyard.

variants.label: modifier 3
variants.delta: A targets Centaur Courser instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Final result is 12 + 3 = 15, in the 15+ range. Centaur Courser moves to A's hand and A gains 3 life (23). Grizzly Bears stays in the graveyard.

variants.label: natural 13
variants.delta: The natural result is 13 instead of 12.
variants.expected: Final result is 13 + 2 = 15, in the 15+ range. Grizzly Bears moves to A's hand and A gains 2 life (22).

scenarios.forge_notes: Modifier$ X is applied after the natural result; the dice_rolled note records natural and final values per die.

scenarios.title: A result that no range of the results table contains makes no effect happen

setup.notes: The natural d6 result is fixed by the scenario, not random. Library order is bottom last; the order is observable because a search shuffles it.

decisions: A casts Goblin Tutor, tapping Mountain.
Both players pass; Goblin Tutor resolves.
A rolls a d6; the natural result is 4. A searches for Sol Ring.

variants.label: roll 4
variants.expected: The 4 entry applies: A searches the library for an artifact, Sol Ring moves to A's hand, and the library is shuffled. Goblin Tutor moves to A's graveyard.

variants.label: roll 1
variants.delta: The natural result is 1 instead of 4.
variants.expected: No range of the table contains 1, so nothing happens: A's hand is empty, the library still holds Sol Ring, Shock and Mountain in their original order and is not shuffled. Goblin Tutor moves to A's graveyard.

variants.label: roll 6
variants.delta: The natural result is 6 instead of 4; A searches for Shock.
variants.expected: The 6 entry applies: Shock (an instant) moves from the library to A's hand and the library is shuffled. Sol Ring stays in the library.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge's ResultSubAbilities for Goblin Tutor omit a key for 1, so no sub-ability resolves.

scenarios.title: A Roll again result rolls the same kind of die again and the new result selects the effect

setup.notes: The natural d20 results are fixed by the scenario, in order, not random.

decisions: A declares Delina, Wild Mage as the only attacker.
Delina's attack trigger goes on the stack, targeting Grizzly Bears.
Both players pass; the trigger resolves and A rolls a d20: the first natural result is 16.
A creates a tapped and attacking token copy of Grizzly Bears and, after every result of 15-20, chooses to roll again; the second natural result is 8.
Both players pass through combat with no blocks; combat damage is dealt, and at end of combat the tokens are exiled.

variants.label: 16 then 8
variants.expected: The first roll (16) creates one token and rolls again with another d20. The second roll (8) creates one more token and stops. Two attacking Grizzly Bears tokens, so B takes 3 + 2 + 2 and ends at 13. The tokens are exiled at end of combat.

variants.label: 10 first
variants.delta: The first natural result is 10 instead of 16.
variants.expected: The 10 is in the 1-14 range: one token, no further roll. B takes 3 + 2 and ends at 15.
The first 16 creates a token and rolls again; the second 16 creates another and rolls again; the 3 creates a third and stops. Three tokens, so B takes 3 + 2 + 2 + 2 and ends at 11.

scenarios.forge_notes: Implemented with Repeat/RepeatOptional and an SVar RepeatCheck set by the 15-20 and 1-14 sub-abilities.

scenarios.title: Celebr-8000 gains double strike only when both dice show equal results

setup.notes: The natural d6 results are fixed by the scenario, not random.

decisions: Celebr-8000's beginning-of-combat trigger goes on the stack.
Both players pass; the trigger resolves and A rolls two six-sided dice: the results are 3 and 3.

variants.label: doubles
variants.expected: Both dice show 3, so Celebr-8000 gains vigilance and, because the results are equal, double strike until end of turn. It stays a 3/3.

variants.label: not doubles
variants.expected: Celebr-8000 gains vigilance and lifelink until end of turn and does not gain double strike. It stays a 3/3.

variants.label: doubles of ones
variants.expected: Each 1 gives +1/+1, so Celebr-8000 is a 5/5 with double strike until end of turn and gains no other ability.

scenarios.forge_notes: NoteDoubles$ True records equality and ConditionCheckSVar Doubles gates the double strike sub-ability.

scenarios.title: An ignored roll never happened, so it triggers nothing

setup.notes: The natural d6 results are fixed by the scenario, in order: the first die rolled is 1 and the second is 3.

decisions: A activates Steel Squirrel's {6} ability (roll a six-sided die), tapping six Mountains.
Both players pass; the ability resolves. Wyll's replacement makes A roll two d6 instead of one and ignore the lowest roll.

variants.label: low roll ignored
variants.expected: A rolls 1 and 3 and the 1 is ignored. Complaints Clerk's roll-a-1 trigger does not fire and no Clown Robot token is created. Steel Squirrel does not trigger and stays 1/1. Wyll's roll trigger fires once and Wyll gets one +1/+1 counter (2/2).

variants.label: no Wyll
variants.delta: Wyll, Blade of Frontiers is not on the battlefield.
variants.expected: A rolls one d6 with natural result 1 and nothing is ignored. Complaints Clerk's trigger fires and A creates a 1/1 white Clown Robot artifact creature token. Steel Squirrel stays 1/1.

variants.label: tie for lowest
variants.delta: The second natural result is 1 instead of 3.
variants.expected: A rolls 1 and 1; one of the tied 1s is ignored and the other is kept. Complaints Clerk's trigger fires once and A creates exactly one 1/1 Clown Robot token. Wyll gets one +1/+1 counter (2/2).

scenarios.forge_notes: Wyll's RollDice replacement raises the die count and sets Ignore; ignored dice are dropped before RolledDie triggers run. Complaints Clerk's Attraction enters trigger is irrelevant because it starts on the battlefield.

scenarios.title: Rolling dice with a storing ability records each die's kind and value on the permanent

setup.notes: The natural d6 results are fixed by the scenario, not random.

decisions: A casts Centaur of Attention, tapping five Forests.
Both players pass; Centaur of Attention resolves and its enter trigger goes on the stack.
Both players pass; the trigger resolves and A rolls five six-sided dice: the results are 4, 4, 4, 1 and 2.

variants.label: three of a kind
variants.expected: Five stored results (4, 4, 4, 1, 2) are noted on Centaur of Attention. The greatest number of equal stored results is 3, so it is a 6/6.

variants.label: all different
variants.expected: Five stored results (1 to 5) are noted. The greatest number of equal stored results is 1, so it is a 4/4.

variants.label: trigger disabled
variants.delta: Torpor Orb is on B's battlefield instead of in B's library.
variants.expected: The enter trigger does not fire, no dice are rolled and nothing is stored. Centaur of Attention is a 3/3.

scenarios.forge_notes: Stored results are tracked through StoreResults$ True and read by Count$MaxSameStoredRolls.

scenarios.title: Rerolling stored results rolls one die of each noted kind and replaces the old stored results

setup.notes: Centaur of Attention has stored results 4, 4, 1, 2, 3 (all six-sided), so it is a 5/5. The natural d6 results of any reroll are fixed by the scenario, not random.

decisions: Centaur of Attention's beginning-of-combat trigger goes on the stack.
Both players pass; the trigger resolves. A chooses to reroll the stored results 1, 2 and 3, and rolls three six-sided dice: the results are 4, 4 and 6.

variants.label: reroll three
variants.expected: The stored 1, 2 and 3 stop being stored and the new 4, 4 and 6 are stored. Stored results are 4, 4, 4, 4, 6; the greatest number of equal results is 4, so it is a 7/7.

variants.label: reroll none
variants.expected: No dice are rolled. Stored results stay 4, 4, 1, 2, 3, so it stays a 5/5.

variants.label: reroll one of a pair
variants.delta: A rerolls one stored 4 only, and the result is 5.
variants.expected: That 4 stops being stored and the 5 is stored. Stored results are 4, 1, 2, 3, 5; the greatest number of equal results is 1, so it is a 4/4.

scenarios.forge_notes: Needs the Centaur to start with prearranged stored results; reach this by running its enter trigger with forced die results earlier in the puzzle setup. Forge implements the reroll as RerollResults$ True.
